relations.text: 連携センターの連携先にSalesforceが含まれている
relations.text_en: Salesforce is among the tools in monday.com's integration center

source.label: monday.com 20-F
source.quote: Currently, our integration center includes integrations with other tools, such as Gmail, Outlook, Jira, Salesforce, Google Drive, Dropbox, Stripe, Slack, GitHub, and Zendesk.

relations.text: 主要テック企業の提携先の例としてAmazon AWSを挙げている
relations.text_en: Amazon AWS is named as an example of leading tech company partners

source.label: monday.com 20-F
source.quote: We have partnered with some of the world's leading tech companies, such as Amazon AWS, as well as with a broad set of independent software vendors, in order to increase in scope, deepen our products, and strengthen our ability to serve as the connective layer across organizations.

relations.text: モバイルアプリは、Appleなどが管理するアプリストアで配布されている
relations.text_en: The mobile app is distributed through app stores managed by Apple, among others

source.label: monday.com 20-F
source.quote: We distribute the mobile monday.com application through smartphone and tablet application stores managed by Apple and Google, among others.

relations.text: マンデー・ドットコムの年次報告が、競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Named as a competitor in monday.com’s annual report

source.label: monday.com 20-F
source.quote: For example, we currently directly compete with several large technology companies whose applications interface with our products, including Google and Microsoft.

relations.text: モバイルアプリは、Googleなどが管理するアプリストアでも配布されている
relations.text_en: The mobile app is also distributed through app stores managed by Google

source.label: monday.com 20-F
source.quote: We distribute the mobile monday.com application through smartphone and tablet application stores managed by Apple and Google, among others.
